title: 第二十一章 神通蜕变第二十二章 定风珠
slug: 西游从蜈蚣精到百目真君
content_zh:
镇元大仙从青石台基上缓缓站起，目光扫过座下众人，面色依旧平淡如水。
他没有说散场，也没有说后会有期。只是抬起右手，在虚空中轻轻一按。
这一按，天地变色。
整座万寿山轰然一震。
那不是山崩地裂的震颤，而是大地本身在响应他的召唤。
一股浩瀚到无法用语言形容的大地之力从山脉最深处涌出。
从每一寸土地中喷薄而起，从四百余位地仙身下的蒲团中直贯而入。
与此同时，观门内那株混沌初分时便已存世的人参果树无风自动。
万千叶片齐齐震颤，发出一阵古老而悠远的沙沙声，与大地之力交相呼应。
平台、古松、山门、石阶，所有景象都在这一瞬间消失了。
四百余位地仙的神识同时被一股磅礴而温和的力量裹住，沉入了一片无边无际的大地意境之中。
天穹低垂，大地无垠。
远处群山如巨龙横卧，近处江河似银带蜿蜒。
脚下的土地苍茫厚重，每一粒土壤都散发着亘古洪荒的气息。
一条条纵横交错的脉络在大地深处隐隐搏动。
那是地脉大地之力的运行轨迹，如同人体经络一般贯穿了整片大陆。
地脉之中流淌着大地最本源的道韵，那是一种比山脉更古老、比海洋更深厚的力量。
这是大地之道。
承载万物而不言，生养万物而不矜，藏纳污浊而不厌，托举山河而不重。
镇元大仙的声音在每个人的灵台深处响起。

只说了八个字，声音不大，却震得每个人的神魂都在共鸣。
“大地载物，各取其道。”
这是镇元大仙以无上神通展现的大地之道。
大地载万物而不言，生养万物而不矜，藏污纳垢而不厌，承山河而不重。
这份意境超脱了言语与文字，越过肉身与经脉，直接落入了在场每个人的神魂深处。
不是讲道，不是传法，而是镇元大仙将大地之道的本源硬生生剖开，铺在了四百余位地仙面前。
能悟多少，不看修为，不看年岁，只看根器与造化。
平台之上，四百余位地仙的神识齐齐沉入了这片浩瀚无边的意境之中。
天幕低垂，大地苍茫，远处群山如龙脊横卧，近处江河似素练蜿蜒。
脚下的土壤每一粒都散发着亘古洪荒的气息，厚重得像是承载了开天辟地以来的所有岁月。
大地深处，无数条纵横交错的脉络正在隐隐搏动。
那是地脉，是大地之力运转的轨迹，如人之经络，贯穿山川，连通河海，将草木沙石、峰峦幽谷尽数纳为一体。
妖族修士最先起了感应。
大地之道直指本源，与妖族血脉最是相契。
妖族修行，根在血脉，血脉愈古老，与大道本源的联系便愈紧密。
此刻被大地意境一激，百余位妖修体内的血脉如同滚汤般沸腾起来。
那些沉睡在血脉最深处的远古记忆被大地之道悍然唤醒，发出跨越万古的共鸣。
平台之上，妖气冲霄。
一头虎妖仰天咆哮，身躯迎风便涨，衣袍寸裂，化作一头数丈长的吊睛白额巨虎。
伏于地上，周身黄芒流转如披甲胄，虎目之中竟有山河虚影一闪而逝。

一头苍狼精伏地长嗥，背后浮出一尊百丈银狼虚影，狼首俯瞰，眸光苍茫如对亘古。
content_en:
Immortal Zhenyuan slowly stood up from the bluestone platform, his eyes swept over the people sitting down, his expression remained as calm as water.
He didn't say it was time to leave, nor did he say we would meet again later. He just raised his right hand and pressed lightly in the void.
With this press, the color of heaven and earth changes.
The entire Wanshou Mountain shook with a loud bang.
It was not the tremor of landslides and earthquakes, but the earth itself responding to his call.
A force of earth so vast that it cannot be described in words surged out from the deepest part of the mountain range.
It erupted from every inch of the land and penetrated directly into the futons under the bodies of more than four hundred earth immortals.
At the same time, the ginseng fruit tree inside the gate, which had existed since the beginning of chaos, moved without any wind.
Thousands of leaves trembled together, making an ancient and distant rustling sound, echoing the power of the earth.
The platform, ancient pines, mountain gates, stone steps, all the scenes disappeared in this moment.
The consciousnesses of more than four hundred earth immortals were simultaneously enveloped by a majestic and gentle force, sinking into the boundless artistic conception of the earth.
The sky is low and the earth is endless.
The mountains in the distance are like giant dragons, and the rivers nearby are like silver ribbons.
The land underfoot is vast and thick, and every grain of soil exudes the atmosphere of ancient times.
The crisscrossing veins pulse faintly deep in the earth.
That is the trajectory of the power of the earth, running through the entire continent like the meridians of the human body.
The most original Taoist charm of the earth flows in the earth's veins, which is a power older than the mountains and deeper than the ocean.
This is the way of the earth.
It carries all things without saying anything, gives birth to all things without being embarrassed, stores away filth without getting tired of it, and lifts mountains and rivers without being heavy.
Immortal Zhenyuan's voice sounded deep in everyone's spiritual platform.
He only said eight words, his voice was not loud, but it made everyone's soul resonate.
“The earth carries all things, each in his own way.”
This is the way of the earth demonstrated by Immortal Zhenyuan with his supreme magical power.
The earth carries all things without mentioning them, grows and nourishes all things without being cautious, hides dirt without getting tired of it, and carries mountains and rivers without being heavy.
This artistic conception transcends words and words, transcends the physical body and meridians, and directly falls into the soul of everyone present.
It was not a sermon or a teaching, but the Immortal Zhenyuan cut open the origin of the Tao of the Earth and laid it out in front of more than four hundred Earth Immortals.
How much you can realize does not depend on your cultivation level or your age, but only on your abilities and luck.
On the platform, the consciousness of more than four hundred earthly immortals sank into this vast and boundless artistic conception.
The sky is low, the earth is vast, the mountains in the distance lie like a dragon's spine, and the rivers nearby seem to be winding.
Every grain of soil under your feet exudes the atmosphere of eternity, and is so thick that it seems to have carried all the years since the beginning of the world.
Deep in the earth, countless criss-crossing veins are pulsing faintly.
Those are earth veins, which are the tracks of the power of the earth. They are like human meridians, running through mountains and rivers, connecting rivers and seas, and integrating vegetation, sand, rocks, peaks and valleys into one.
The demon monks were the first to sense it.
The way of the earth points directly to the origin, and is most compatible with the blood of the demon clan.
The practice of the demon clan is rooted in blood. The older the blood, the closer the connection with the origin of the avenue.
At this moment, stirred by the artistic conception of the earth, the blood in the bodies of more than a hundred demon cultivators boiled like boiling soup.
Those ancient memories sleeping in the deepest part of the bloodline were boldly awakened by the way of the earth, and resonated across the ages.
On the platform, demonic energy surged into the sky.
A tiger monster looked up to the sky and roared, its body swelled in the wind, its robes torn apart, and it transformed into a giant tiger with a striking white forehead that was several feet long.
Lying on the ground, the yellow light flowing around his body was like armor, and in the tiger's eyes, there were phantoms of mountains and rivers flashing away.
A gray wolf spirit lay on the ground and howled, and a shadow of a hundred-foot-long silver wolf emerged from behind. The wolf's head looked down, and its eyes were as blank as looking into eternity.
